name: real-questions
description: The day's real questions, as asked: every question below was asked by the owner or the agent during the 16/11 extraction-cascade arc (English since the 26/11 sweep), and each must retrieve the document that holds its answer in the top 5 hybrid hits. Unlike recall-core (curated paraphrase pairs), this suite is the usage truth: it grows every time a real question exposes a gap. MEASURED 16/11 night: 7/8 (gate 0.8 PASSES) after the bilingual second leg (QueryExpansion: a chat restatement in English fused with the original by RRF) and the two corpus gaps it exposed were filled (worker-queue.md; the degeneration paragraph in extraction-model.md). The one remaining miss was the queue question whose Spanish wording was ambiguous travel vocabulary — the distractor won that one legitimately, an honest edge worth keeping in mind. Translated to English on 26/11 (the English sweep): every question keeps its intent and its expected uri, and the verbatim Spanish originals stay in git history.
